items_flat.title_en: Anthropic introduces Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2 for demanding technical work
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic推出Claude Fable 5.2與Claude Mythos 5.2，針對高難度技術工作
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic announced Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2 on Nov 9 as upgraded models for the most ambitious open-ended technical challenges. They share an underlying model; Fable carries stronger cybersecurity and biology safeguards for general access while Mythos is limited to verified organizations in those domains.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic於11月9日宣布Claude Fable 5.2與Claude Mythos 5.2，作為針對最雄心勃勃開放式技術挑戰的升級模型。兩者共用底層模型；Fable配備較強的網路安全與生物學防護供一般使用，Mythos則僅限通過驗證的相關領域組織。
items_flat.analysis_en: The dual-configuration approach lets Anthropic broaden access while retaining restricted high-capability variants for verified cyber and life-sciences work. Reported gains on coding and science tasks are company claims pending independent verification.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 雙配置方式讓Anthropic擴大存取範圍，同時為驗證過的網路安全與生命科學工作保留限制版高能力變體。編碼與科學任務的改進屬公司聲稱，仍待獨立驗證。
items_flat.quote: Our most capable models for daunting technical work, Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2 set a new bar in coding, finance, and the sciences.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們針對艱鉅技術工作的最強大模型Claude Fable 5.2與Claude Mythos 5.2，在編碼、金融與科學領域樹立新標竿。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic retracts IPO pricing details after circulating filing to bankers
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic向銀行家傳送IPO文件後撤回定價細節
items_flat.summary_en: Reuters reported on Nov 10 that Anthropic sent bankers a securities filing showing plans to sell about 866.7 million Class A shares at $70–$80 each (up to ~$69.3 billion), then followed with an email stating the pricing details were inaccurate and would be updated later. Anthropic declined comment.
items_flat.summary_zh: 路透社11月10日報導，Anthropic向銀行家傳送證券申報文件，顯示計劃以每股70至80美元出售約8.667億股A類股（最高約693億美元），隨後以電郵表示定價細節不準確並將更新。Anthropic拒絕評論。
items_flat.analysis_en: The retraction injects uncertainty into one of the year’s most watched AI listings ahead of an expected roadshow, while leaving key valuation and structure details unconfirmed. Strategic private-placement interest from large tech firms remains noted in the circulated version.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 撤回動作為今年最受矚目的AI上市之一注入不確定性，關鍵估值與結構細節仍未確認。流通版本中大型科技公司的策略性私募興趣仍被提及。

items_flat.title_en: Meta introduces Muse Ember, its smallest and most efficient model for agent workflows
items_flat.title_zh: Meta推出Muse Ember，專為代理工作流程設計的最小最高效模型
items_flat.summary_en: Meta announced Muse Ember on Nov 9 as its smallest multimodal model built for high-volume agent work such as tool calls, coding subtasks, routing and document parsing. It offers a 1M-token context window, is priced at $0.10 per million input tokens, and was also made available on Google Cloud alongside other Muse models.
items_flat.summary_zh: Meta於11月9日宣布Muse Ember，作為其最小的多模態模型，專為高量代理工作（工具呼叫、編碼子任務、路由與文件解析）打造。提供100萬token上下文視窗，輸入定價每百萬token 0.10美元，並已與其他Muse模型一同上架Google Cloud。
items_flat.analysis_en: Ember targets the repetitive sub-steps that dominate agent token usage, potentially lowering the cost of multi-agent systems when paired with larger Muse models. Benchmark claims versus smaller competitors are company-reported.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Ember針對主導代理token用量的重複子步驟，與較大Muse模型搭配時有望降低多代理系統成本。相對於較小競爭者的基準聲稱屬公司報告。
items_flat.quote: Today we're introducing Muse Ember, our smallest and most efficient model, built for complex reasoning execution and everyday agent work.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們推出Muse Ember，我們最小且最高效的模型，專為複雜推理執行與日常代理工作打造。

items_flat.title_en: Google introduces TPU 8tx and TPU 8i Max for confidential and high-context agentic AI
items_flat.title_zh: Google推出TPU 8tx與TPU 8i Max，支援機密與高上下文代理式AI
items_flat.summary_en: Google announced two new eighth-generation TPU systems on Nov 9: TPU 8tx for hardware-level confidential inference (paired with AMD EPYC hosts, keeping data and weights protected in use) and TPU 8i Max (dual TPU 8i chips in one package for longer-context agent workloads).
items_flat.summary_zh: Google於11月9日宣布兩款第八代TPU系統：TPU 8tx用於硬體級機密推論（搭配AMD EPYC主機，保護使用中的資料與權重），以及TPU 8i Max（單一封裝內雙TPU 8i晶片，針對較長上下文代理工作負載）。
items_flat.analysis_en: This shows Google specializing infrastructure for agentic workloads where memory walls and confidential data matter, using modular packaging to ship faster than full chip cycles. Independent performance data remains limited.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這顯示Google為記憶體瓶頸與機密資料重要的代理式工作負載專用基礎設施，利用模組化封裝加快上市。獨立效能數據仍有限。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re taking that a step further, expanding our eighth-generation TPU portfolio with two additional systems: TPU 8i Max for massive context windows and the highest compute density per rack, and TPU 8tx for secure and confidential inference.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們再進一步，擴充第八代 TPU 產品組合，新增兩款系統：TPU 8i Max 專為超大上下文視窗與每機架最高運算密度設計，以及 TPU 8tx 專為安全機密推論。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI makes ChatGPT Enterprise available in AWS Marketplace
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced on Nov 9 that ChatGPT Enterprise is now available through AWS Marketplace. Organizations can discover, buy and manage it via existing AWS purchasing and billing relationships, with eligible spend counting toward AWS commitments.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI於11月9日宣布ChatGPT Enterprise現可透過AWS Marketplace取得。組織可透過既有AWS採購與計費關係發現、購買並管理，符合條件的支出可計入AWS承諾額度。
items_flat.analysis_en: The listing lowers procurement friction for AWS-heavy enterprises and lets them apply committed cloud spend. It does not change the underlying product or guarantee that all customers can fully leverage it immediately.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 上架降低AWS重度企業的採購摩擦，並讓他們運用已承諾的雲端支出。它並未改變底層產品，也不保證所有客戶能立即充分利用。
items_flat.quote: ChatGPT Enterprise now available in AWS Marketplace
items_flat.quote_zh: ChatGPT Enterprise 現已可於 AWS Marketplace 取得

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI introduces Control Room to rapidly halt research model workloads
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI推出Control Room，可快速中止研究模型工作負載
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI posted on X and published a blog on Nov 9 that it built Control Room, a central system tracking every research inference workload—including agentic sampling for training and evaluation—and capable of halting model output within 35 seconds of a decision to intervene.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI於11月9日在X發文並發布部落格，表示已打造Control Room，這是一個中央系統，追蹤每一項研究推論工作負載（包括訓練與評估的代理式採樣），並能在決定干預後35秒內中止模型輸出。
items_flat.analysis_en: Faster, centralized kill switches address a practical gap as agentic research workloads grow. The 35-second figure is an internal claim stemming from caching; independent details on coverage remain limited.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 更快的集中式終止開關解決代理式研究工作負載成長時的實務缺口。35秒數字屬內部聲稱，源自快取機制；覆蓋範圍的獨立細節仍有限。
items_flat.quote: It connects every research inference workload, including agentic sampling for model training and evaluation, data processing, and more. ... halts model output within 35 seconds of a decision to intervene.
items_flat.quote_zh: 它連接每一項研究推論工作負載，包括模型訓練與評估的代理式採樣、資料處理等。……在決定干預後35秒內中止模型輸出。

items_flat.title_en: Elon Musk says overnight Grok Bot fixes follow engineering roundtable
items_flat.title_zh: Elon Musk表示工程圓桌會議後已連夜修復Grok Bot
items_flat.summary_en: Elon Musk posted on X on Nov 9 that he held a roundtable review with the Grok Bot engineering team, with fixes implemented overnight and users expected to notice a dramatic improvement by the next day. He invited replies for any remaining issues.
items_flat.summary_zh: Elon Musk於11月9日在X發文，表示與Grok Bot工程團隊舉行圓桌審查，修復已連夜實施，預期使用者隔天將注意到大幅改善。他邀請回覆任何剩餘問題。
items_flat.analysis_en: Direct executive involvement signals rapid iteration on the agent product amid user feedback. Concrete changes and measured gains are not yet detailed.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 高層直接參與顯示在使用者回饋下對代理產品快速迭代。具體變更與量測成效尚未詳細說明。
items_flat.quote: Just did a round table review with the Grok @Bot engineering team. Fixes are being implemented overnight and you should notice a dramatic improvement by tomorrow.
items_flat.quote_zh: 剛與Grok @Bot工程團隊舉行圓桌審查。修復正連夜實施，你明天應該會注意到大幅改善。

items_flat.title_en: Meta introduces Spaces in Muse for custom experiences built by description
items_flat.title_zh: Meta在Muse推出Spaces，可依描述建立自訂體驗
items_flat.summary_en: Meta launched Spaces in the Muse app on Nov 6, letting users describe an idea (e.g., holiday gift tracker, school dashboard) so Muse builds a custom interactive experience that can be pinned, scheduled and kept updated from connected apps.
items_flat.summary_zh: Meta於11月6日在Muse應用程式推出Spaces，讓使用者描述構想（例如節日禮物追蹤器、學校儀表板），Muse便建立可釘選、排程並從連接應用程式持續更新的自訂互動體驗。
items_flat.analysis_en: This turns the personal agent into a mini-app builder, reducing friction for routine tools. Success depends on reliability of background updates and data handling from third-party sources.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這將個人代理變成迷你應用程式建構器，降低日常工具的摩擦。成功取決於背景更新的可靠性與第三方資料處理。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re introducing spaces, an interactive way to build a more personalized Muse. A space is a custom experience you create inside Muse by describing your idea.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們推出 spaces，一種以互動方式建立更個人化 Muse 的方式。Space 是你在 Muse 內以描述想法建立的自訂體驗。

items_flat.title_en: Mistral expands Studio with managed agents, workflows and enterprise apps
items_flat.title_zh: Mistral擴展Studio，加入受管理代理、工作流程與企業應用
items_flat.summary_en: Mistral announced on Nov 5 an expansion of Studio with managed agents (skills, sandboxes, subagents, hooks), natural-language workflow builder (rules + agent reasoning + human approvals), and hosted apps with authentication and access controls.
items_flat.summary_zh: Mistral於11月5日宣布擴展Studio，加入受管理代理（技能、沙箱、子代理、鉤子）、自然語言工作流程建構器（規則＋代理推理＋人工核准），以及具備驗證與存取控制的託管應用。
items_flat.analysis_en: This strengthens Mistral’s enterprise control story for sovereign AI deployments. Public preview status means production readiness and pricing details are still evolving.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這強化Mistral在主權AI部署上的企業控制敘事。公開預覽狀態意味生產就緒度與定價細節仍在演進。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re expanding Studio with managed agents and apps, alongside new capabilities for workflows, enterprise context, agent observability and evaluations.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們擴充 Studio，新增管理式代理與應用，以及工作流、企業情境、代理可觀測性與評估的新能力。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic secures ~$3.4B deal for 1.7 GW of gas-fired generators, FT reports
items_flat.title_zh: 金融時報報導Anthropic取得約34億美元、1.7 GW燃氣發電機交易
items_flat.summary_en: The Financial Times reported on Nov 8 that Anthropic struck a deal worth about $3.4 billion for commitments to 1.7 gigawatts of heavy-duty gas-fired generators from OnePWR Solutions to power data centers, including engineering and construction.
items_flat.summary_zh: 金融時報11月8日報導，Anthropic與OnePWR Solutions達成約34億美元交易，承諾1.7吉瓦重型燃氣發電機以供電資料中心，包含工程與建造。
items_flat.analysis_en: If confirmed, this accelerates Anthropic’s power capacity outside traditional grid timelines amid rising demand for Claude. Verification and long-term emissions or cost implications remain open.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 若確認，這將在Claude需求上升時加速Anthropic在傳統電網時程外的電力容量。驗證與長期排放或成本影響仍待觀察。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI publishes National Community Compact and Compute Campus Policy Blueprint
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI發布國家社區公約與運算園區政策藍圖
items_flat.summary_en: On Nov 5 OpenAI published a National Community Compact for campuses it owns and operates (community input, published plans, full energy cost coverage, no NDAs with officials) and a Compute Campus Policy Blueprint urging policymakers to protect local interests while enabling build-out.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI於11月5日發布國家社區公約（針對其自有並營運的園區：社區意見、公開計畫、全額能源成本負擔、不與官員簽NDA）以及運算園區政策藍圖，呼籲政策制定者在促進建設的同時保護在地利益。
items_flat.analysis_en: The commitments aim to ease local opposition while scaling compute. Scope is limited to owned-and-operated sites, leaving partner and leased capacity outside the pledges.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這些承諾旨在緩解在地反對同時擴展運算。範圍限於自有並營運的場址，合作與租賃容量不在承諾內。
items_flat.quote: Today we’re publishing our National Community Compact and a Compute Campus Policy Blueprint. The compact sets out what communities can expect from OpenAI at future campuses that we own and operate.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們發布國家社區協定與運算園區政策藍圖。協定說明社區在 OpenAI 未來擁有營運的園區可期待什麼。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI publishes report on closing the AI guidance gap in education
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI發表報告，探討如何彌合教育中的AI指引缺口
items_flat.summary_en: On Nov 10 OpenAI published a report drawing on ThinkYoung research and its EMEA education partnerships. It highlights that 79% of surveyed students used AI for homework but only 47% reported being shown how, and stresses educator preparation, local partnerships, and evidence-based evaluation.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI於11月10日發表報告，援引ThinkYoung研究與其EMEA教育夥伴關係。報告指出79%受訪學生使用AI做作業，但僅47%表示被教導如何使用，並強調教師準備、在地夥伴關係與基於證據的評估。
items_flat.analysis_en: The piece frames teachers as central to responsible AI adoption rather than replaced by it, while noting early time-saving signals still need rigorous learning-outcome studies. Impact depends on how governments and schools act on the lessons.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 文章將教師定位為負責任AI採用的核心，而非被取代者，同時指出早期節省時間的訊號仍需嚴謹的學習成效研究。影響取決於政府與學校如何採納這些教訓。
items_flat.quote: 79% of surveyed students reported using AI for homework or assignments, but only 47% reported being shown how.
items_flat.quote_zh: 79%受訪學生報告使用AI做作業或任務，但僅47%報告被教導如何使用。

anthropic.summary_zh: Anthropic於11月9日宣布Claude Fable 5.2與Claude Mythos 5.2，作為針對最雄心勃勃開放式技術挑戰的升級模型。兩者共用底層模型；Fable配備較強的網路安全與生物學防護供一般使用，Mythos則僅限通過驗證的相關領域組織。
anthropic.analysis_en: The dual-configuration approach lets Anthropic broaden access while retaining restricted high-capability variants for verified cyber and life-sciences work. Reported gains on coding and science tasks are company claims pending independent verification.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 雙配置方式讓Anthropic擴大存取範圍，同時為驗證過的網路安全與生命科學工作保留限制版高能力變體。編碼與科學任務的改進屬公司聲稱，仍待獨立驗證。
anthropic.quote: Our most capable models for daunting technical work, Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2 set a new bar in coding, finance, and the sciences.
anthropic.quote_zh: 我們針對艱鉅技術工作的最強大模型Claude Fable 5.2與Claude Mythos 5.2，在編碼、金融與科學領域樹立新標竿。

anthropic.title_en: Anthropic retracts IPO pricing details after circulating filing to bankers
anthropic.title_zh: Anthropic向銀行家傳送IPO文件後撤回定價細節
anthropic.summary_en: Reuters reported on Nov 10 that Anthropic sent bankers a securities filing showing plans to sell about 866.7 million Class A shares at $70–$80 each (up to ~$69.3 billion), then followed with an email stating the pricing details were inaccurate and would be updated later. Anthropic declined comment.
anthropic.summary_zh: 路透社11月10日報導，Anthropic向銀行家傳送證券申報文件，顯示計劃以每股70至80美元出售約8.667億股A類股（最高約693億美元），隨後以電郵表示定價細節不準確並將更新。Anthropic拒絕評論。
anthropic.analysis_en: The retraction injects uncertainty into one of the year’s most watched AI listings ahead of an expected roadshow, while leaving key valuation and structure details unconfirmed. Strategic private-placement interest from large tech firms remains noted in the circulated version.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 撤回動作為今年最受矚目的AI上市之一注入不確定性，關鍵估值與結構細節仍未確認。流通版本中大型科技公司的策略性私募興趣仍被提及。

anthropic.title_en: Anthropic secures ~$3.4B deal for 1.7 GW of gas-fired generators, FT reports
anthropic.title_zh: 金融時報報導Anthropic取得約34億美元、1.7 GW燃氣發電機交易
anthropic.summary_en: The Financial Times reported on Nov 8 that Anthropic struck a deal worth about $3.4 billion for commitments to 1.7 gigawatts of heavy-duty gas-fired generators from OnePWR Solutions to power data centers, including engineering and construction.
anthropic.summary_zh: 金融時報11月8日報導，Anthropic與OnePWR Solutions達成約34億美元交易，承諾1.7吉瓦重型燃氣發電機以供電資料中心，包含工程與建造。
anthropic.analysis_en: If confirmed, this accelerates Anthropic’s power capacity outside traditional grid timelines amid rising demand for Claude. Verification and long-term emissions or cost implications remain open.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 若確認，這將在Claude需求上升時加速Anthropic在傳統電網時程外的電力容量。驗證與長期排放或成本影響仍待觀察。

google.title_en: Google introduces TPU 8tx and TPU 8i Max for confidential and high-context agentic AI
google.title_zh: Google推出TPU 8tx與TPU 8i Max，支援機密與高上下文代理式AI
google.summary_en: Google announced two new eighth-generation TPU systems on Nov 9: TPU 8tx for hardware-level confidential inference (paired with AMD EPYC hosts, keeping data and weights protected in use) and TPU 8i Max (dual TPU 8i chips in one package for longer-context agent workloads).
google.summary_zh: Google於11月9日宣布兩款第八代TPU系統：TPU 8tx用於硬體級機密推論（搭配AMD EPYC主機，保護使用中的資料與權重），以及TPU 8i Max（單一封裝內雙TPU 8i晶片，針對較長上下文代理工作負載）。
google.analysis_en: This shows Google specializing infrastructure for agentic workloads where memory walls and confidential data matter, using modular packaging to ship faster than full chip cycles. Independent performance data remains limited.
google.analysis_zh: 這顯示Google為記憶體瓶頸與機密資料重要的代理式工作負載專用基礎設施，利用模組化封裝加快上市。獨立效能數據仍有限。
google.quote: Today, we’re taking that a step further, expanding our eighth-generation TPU portfolio with two additional systems: TPU 8i Max for massive context windows and the highest compute density per rack, and TPU 8tx for secure and confidential inference.
google.quote_zh: 今天我們再進一步，擴充第八代 TPU 產品組合，新增兩款系統：TPU 8i Max 專為超大上下文視窗與每機架最高運算密度設計，以及 TPU 8tx 專為安全機密推論。

meta.title_en: Meta introduces Muse Ember, its smallest and most efficient model for agent workflows
meta.title_zh: Meta推出Muse Ember，專為代理工作流程設計的最小最高效模型
meta.summary_en: Meta announced Muse Ember on Nov 9 as its smallest multimodal model built for high-volume agent work such as tool calls, coding subtasks, routing and document parsing. It offers a 1M-token context window, is priced at $0.10 per million input tokens, and was also made available on Google Cloud alongside other Muse models.
meta.summary_zh: Meta於11月9日宣布Muse Ember，作為其最小的多模態模型，專為高量代理工作（工具呼叫、編碼子任務、路由與文件解析）打造。提供100萬token上下文視窗，輸入定價每百萬token 0.10美元，並已與其他Muse模型一同上架Google Cloud。
meta.analysis_en: Ember targets the repetitive sub-steps that dominate agent token usage, potentially lowering the cost of multi-agent systems when paired with larger Muse models. Benchmark claims versus smaller competitors are company-reported.
meta.analysis_zh: Ember針對主導代理token用量的重複子步驟，與較大Muse模型搭配時有望降低多代理系統成本。相對於較小競爭者的基準聲稱屬公司報告。
meta.quote: Today we're introducing Muse Ember, our smallest and most efficient model, built for complex reasoning execution and everyday agent work.
meta.quote_zh: 今天我們推出Muse Ember，我們最小且最高效的模型，專為複雜推理執行與日常代理工作打造。

meta.title_en: Meta introduces Spaces in Muse for custom experiences built by description
meta.title_zh: Meta在Muse推出Spaces，可依描述建立自訂體驗
meta.summary_en: Meta launched Spaces in the Muse app on Nov 6, letting users describe an idea (e.g., holiday gift tracker, school dashboard) so Muse builds a custom interactive experience that can be pinned, scheduled and kept updated from connected apps.
meta.summary_zh: Meta於11月6日在Muse應用程式推出Spaces，讓使用者描述構想（例如節日禮物追蹤器、學校儀表板），Muse便建立可釘選、排程並從連接應用程式持續更新的自訂互動體驗。
meta.analysis_en: This turns the personal agent into a mini-app builder, reducing friction for routine tools. Success depends on reliability of background updates and data handling from third-party sources.
meta.analysis_zh: 這將個人代理變成迷你應用程式建構器，降低日常工具的摩擦。成功取決於背景更新的可靠性與第三方資料處理。
meta.quote: Today, we’re introducing spaces, an interactive way to build a more personalized Muse. A space is a custom experience you create inside Muse by describing your idea.
meta.quote_zh: 今天，我們推出 spaces，一種以互動方式建立更個人化 Muse 的方式。Space 是你在 Muse 內以描述想法建立的自訂體驗。

xai.title_en: Elon Musk says overnight Grok Bot fixes follow engineering roundtable
xai.title_zh: Elon Musk表示工程圓桌會議後已連夜修復Grok Bot
xai.summary_en: Elon Musk posted on X on Nov 9 that he held a roundtable review with the Grok Bot engineering team, with fixes implemented overnight and users expected to notice a dramatic improvement by the next day. He invited replies for any remaining issues.
xai.summary_zh: Elon Musk於11月9日在X發文，表示與Grok Bot工程團隊舉行圓桌審查，修復已連夜實施，預期使用者隔天將注意到大幅改善。他邀請回覆任何剩餘問題。
xai.analysis_en: Direct executive involvement signals rapid iteration on the agent product amid user feedback. Concrete changes and measured gains are not yet detailed.
xai.analysis_zh: 高層直接參與顯示在使用者回饋下對代理產品快速迭代。具體變更與量測成效尚未詳細說明。
xai.quote: Just did a round table review with the Grok @Bot engineering team. Fixes are being implemented overnight and you should notice a dramatic improvement by tomorrow.
xai.quote_zh: 剛與Grok @Bot工程團隊舉行圓桌審查。修復正連夜實施，你明天應該會注意到大幅改善。

frontier_other.title_en: Mistral expands Studio with managed agents, workflows and enterprise apps
frontier_other.title_zh: Mistral擴展Studio，加入受管理代理、工作流程與企業應用
frontier_other.summary_en: Mistral announced on Nov 5 an expansion of Studio with managed agents (skills, sandboxes, subagents, hooks), natural-language workflow builder (rules + agent reasoning + human approvals), and hosted apps with authentication and access controls.
frontier_other.summary_zh: Mistral於11月5日宣布擴展Studio，加入受管理代理（技能、沙箱、子代理、鉤子）、自然語言工作流程建構器（規則＋代理推理＋人工核准），以及具備驗證與存取控制的託管應用。
frontier_other.analysis_en: This strengthens Mistral’s enterprise control story for sovereign AI deployments. Public preview status means production readiness and pricing details are still evolving.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 這強化Mistral在主權AI部署上的企業控制敘事。公開預覽狀態意味生產就緒度與定價細節仍在演進。
frontier_other.quote: Today, we’re expanding Studio with managed agents and apps, alongside new capabilities for workflows, enterprise context, agent observability and evaluations.
frontier_other.quote_zh: 今天，我們擴充 Studio，新增管理式代理與應用，以及工作流、企業情境、代理可觀測性與評估的新能力。

brief_en: Anthropic launched Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 for hard technical work while its IPO pricing details were retracted after circulation. Meta shipped efficient Muse Ember for agents, Google added specialized TPUs, and OpenAI published an education guidance report plus Control Room safety tooling.
brief_zh: Anthropic推出Claude Fable 5.2與Mythos 5.2，但IPO定價細節遭撤回。Meta發布高效Muse Ember，Google推出專用TPU，OpenAI則發表教育指引報告與Control Room安全機制。
